findings.value: God's Pantry Food Bank operates a statewide network of partner food pantries, meal sites, senior programs and shelters; the London site is listed as the Southeast Regional Distribution Center (warehouse), not a direct-to-public pantry in this directory.
findings.text_excerpt: Find a Pantry | God's Pantry Food Bank — searchable directory of partner pantries, soup kitchens/meal sites, senior programs and shelters across Central and Eastern Kentucky.

findings.value: God's Pantry Food Bank is a Kentucky food bank serving 50 counties across Central and Eastern Kentucky (48,252,930 lbs distributed FY2026). Programs include partner pantries, produce distribution, mobile pantry, children's programs, healthcare pantry, SNAP assistance, Sharing Thanksgiving, and senior programs. The London location is its Southeast Regional Distribution Center.
findings.text_excerpt: UNTIL NO KENTUCKIAN GOES HUNGRY. ... 50 counties served across Central and Eastern Kentucky ... Programs: Find a pantry, Produce distribution, Mobile pantry, Children's programs, Healthcare pantry program, SNAP assistance, Sharing Thanksgiving, Senior's Program

findings.value: Founded 1955 (first pantry 1959) by Mim Hunt in Lexington. God's Pantry Food Bank is a Feeding America/Feeding Kentucky member that acquires food and distributes it to partner food pantries, soup kitchens, homeless shelters, and schools/youth programs across 50 counties; partner pantries provide food directly to neighbors. Member of Feeding Kentucky and Feeding America.
findings.text_excerpt: As a food bank, we collect food and deliver it to food pantries. Our partner food pantries — located in cities, towns, and neighborhoods across the region — provide it directly to neighbors in need. ... God's Pantry Food Bank was born out of this work in 1955 ... now an organization serving 50 counties

answers.question: Does the London 1215 E 4th St location distribute food directly to individuals/families, or only to partner agencies/pantries?
answers.answer: Only to partner agencies/pantries — no direct walk-in distribution confirmed. God's Pantry's own contact page lists 1215 E 4th St under "Warehouse locations" as the "Southeast Regional Distribution Center," and the org's "Find Food" pantry locator (godspantry.org/help) does NOT list 1215 E 4th St as a pantry site — the only God's Pantry-operated direct-service sites it lists are in Lexington (GPFB Northside, 817 Winchester Rd, Cambridge Dr, etc.). Laurel County direct-service pantries listed there are separate organizations (Calvary Baptist, Fed By Grace, FPC, etc.). The org's direct-to-individual programs (Mobile Pantry, Health Care Pantry) do not include the London warehouse address.

answers.question: Are the hours Monday-Friday 7:00 AM-3:30 PM (per Laurel County Health Dept) current and accurate for public access?
answers.answer: Hours Mon-Fri 7:00 AM-3:30 PM are confirmed as the location's operating hours by the Laurel County Health Dept resource guide, but they are NOT confirmed as public/client access hours — they most likely reflect warehouse/agency receiving hours. God's Pantry's own site publishes no hours for this location, the Find Food tool shows no hours for it, and MapQuest lists it as a business "Closed until 7 am." Could not confirm public-access accuracy without a phone call (606-862-6693), which was not possible in this pass.

answers.question: Is there a separate public-facing pantry or distribution site in London operated by God's Pantry for walk-in clients?
answers.answer: No separate God's Pantry-operated walk-in pantry in London was found. The Find Food locator lists no God's Pantry-branded pantry in London/Laurel County (its own direct pantries are in Lexington only), and the Mobile Pantry program's county list does not include Laurel County. Walk-in food access in London is provided by partner agencies instead — e.g., Calvary Baptist Church (111 N McWhorter St), Come-Unity Co-Op Care (755 S Dixie St), FPC Food Pantry (123 Keavy Rd), Fed By Grace (911 TLC Lane), and Second Mile 541 Outreach (280 Levi Jackson Mill Rd) per the Laurel County Health Dept guide.
